title: UCOS Contract Meta-Schema
description: Canonical, versioned, transport-neutral and implementation-neutral meta-schema for a UCOS contract inventory entry. Validates API, event, and data contract kinds under one root, discriminated by 'contractKind'. Field-level request/response/error schemas are OPTIONAL because UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 is a boundary-level catalog; deferred information is represented via explicit placeholder states, never invented. Additive evolution only.

inventoryFormat.description: Producer format tag of the inventory document. The v1 API inventory uses 'ucos-api-contract.inventory/v1'.

$comment: Intended dialect: JSON Schema draft 2020-12, declared via 'dialect' (the remote dialect keyword is intentionally omitted to keep artifacts offline and deterministic). ADDITIVE EVOLUTION ONLY: future versions may add OPTIONAL properties but MUST NOT remove, rename, or repurpose existing ones. NO implementation-specific fields (no hostnames, protocols, frameworks, serialization, HTTP status codes).

metaSchemaVersion.description: Version of the UCOS contract meta-schema family. Bumped only additively.

placeholderState.description: First-class representation of catalog-level deferrals. These are the ONLY permitted non-concrete states; a generator MUST treat them as 'not defined' and never substitute an invented value.

artifactId.description: A traceable UCOS artifact identifier (e.g. UCOS-API-CONTRACT-018, DOM-018, CAP-10).

contractVersion.description: Contract version as stated by the catalog (e.g. 'v1.0'). Governed by UCOS-SVC-POLICY-001.

payloadRef.description: A reference to a payload family/data entity WITHOUT redefining its field-level schema. Faithful to the catalog: payloads reference PDE-*/LDO-* and inherit classification; field schemas remain owned by the data architecture.

family.description: Named payload family from the data contract (e.g. 'ConfigurationValue').

fieldLevelSchema.description: Either an explicit placeholder (deferred/absent) or a reference to a concrete schema once the data architecture defines it.

extraction.description: Provenance of how this inventory entry was derived from the source-of-record catalog.

emits.description: Event contract(s) emitted by this contract, referenced by id + message names. Delivery semantics are OPTIONAL and additive (deferred in the catalog).

deliverySemantics.description: Optional, additive. Absent in the boundary-level catalog for API-018/027.

nfr.description: Non-functional requirement block. Every value is either concrete or the 'PENDING ASR RATIFICATION' placeholder.

dataContractDetail.description: Reference detail for the owning data contract. Does NOT redefine physical schemas.

generationConstraints.description: Machine-visible constraints instructing generators what MUST NOT be invented.

contract.description: The contract entry. 'contractKind' discriminates API vs event vs data; API contracts require 'operations', event contracts require 'emits.messages', data contracts require 'dataContractDetail'.

contractKind.description: Discriminator. Optional for backward compatibility with v1 API inventories (defaults to 'api').
